images.title: Both numbers grow by 1
images.purpose: Shows that when 23 and 27 both grow by 1 the rectangle gains a column of 23, a row of 27 and one corner, so the product grows by 51.
images.composition: One large rectangle block centred, with a thin strip on its right, a thin strip along its bottom and a tiny corner square where they meet. Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, no scenery, no people, no extra text.
images.exact_structure: A large teal (#0072B2) filled rectangle, 27 units wide and 23 units tall, with the label '27' centred above it and the label '23' centred to its left. Along its right edge, a thin amber (#E69F00) strip 1 unit wide and 23 units tall, labelled '+ 23' just to its right. Along its bottom edge, a thin amber strip 27 units wide and 1 unit tall, labelled '+ 27' just below it. In the bottom right corner where the two strips meet, a tiny 1 by 1 reddish purple (#CC79A7) square, labelled '+ 1' with a short leader line. Below the whole figure, centred, the label '24 × 28 = 621 + 51'. Exactly 1 block, 2 strips, 1 corner square.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: When both numbers grow by 1, the product grows by a + b + 1.
images.description: Shows that when 23 and 27 both grow by 1 the rectangle gains a column of 23, a row of 27 and one corner, so the product grows by 51.

image_decisions.why: The corner square is the piece students forget; the picture shows why the increase is a + b + 1, not a + b.
